reviews.text: Left my dog with a lovely cut and trim 10/10
Just been pampered at Elite dog groomers thank you for looking after me on my first visit.

My dog love here , comes out with little ribbon.
Staff are wonderful you can tell they love animals, best Groomist by far.
Would highly recommend recommend 💕 …
Wonderful to find this great groomer on my doorstep after we recently moved to the area. Toto looked so handsome when I collected him. Thank you Michelle.x

Went in on the off chance I would be able to get my Labrador a wash and dry after Bella decided to get a right mess in the local fields. This was absolutely no problem for the girl who was working that day. Gave me a price and told me it would take 30 minutes which gave me time to get home and get the money.

Overall great service and lovely pleasant staff. Will be back.
Absolutely fabulous service. My dog was so happy and well taken care of. He looks absolutely amazing post groom. He will be back.
Girls were so lovely! You can tell they love their furry clients. My dog was returned to me looking beautiful with a lovely little bow on, and they gave me feedback on how she was during the groom
I am so happy with my baby's groom today, staff are so friendly and professional,  the grooming is so good I have booked her in for her next groom. x
Love bringing my pup Bella here and she loves going! The girls are all so lovely and very good at what they do. Bella always looks and smells amazing when I pick her up.
Oscar loves going there now I know they look after him well  lovely staff will always use them
